_readme: HOW TO ADD A STORE: copy one object from "_example" into the "stores" array below (keep the commas right) and fill it in. Fields: name, url (https://...), description, image (optional: https URL or path like img/shop/store.png), category. The Shop tab shows ONLY "stores"; "_example" is never displayed.

_example.name: PLACEHOLDER — Example Gun & Archery
_example.description: PLACEHOLDER: local gun shop and archery pro shop. Replace with a real partner.

_example.name: PLACEHOLDER — Example Outdoors
_example.description: PLACEHOLDER: hunting clothing, blinds, trail cameras. Replace with a real partner.
